properties.description:
Make real inputs and task placements readable and minimally editable.

Scope

• Inputs / Backlog / Queued / Running / Blocked columns with independent layout.

• Root-only backlog, priority groups, selection, breadcrumb and simple persisted create/move actions.

• No speculative toolbar or drag-only overlay.

• Audit existing table and header components. Reuse/extract header pieces and compose independent column content/scroll; document the chosen shared boundary.

Success criteria

1. Board is populated from persisted real data, not mockup fixtures.

2. Backlog contains only parentless tasks; priorities are ordered 0..n and editable without drag.

3. Columns have no common row grid; selection and scroll survive unrelated updates.

4. Right side stays blank without a selection, and selected task can open its graph.

Evidence

• Focused board browser tests

• Desktop/narrow screenshots

• Real create/move/readback demo
properties.title: Build the independent-column Tasks board
